name: io_destroy
description: The io_destroy() system call attempts to cancel all outstanding asynchronous I/O operations against the specified context, blocks until any uncancelable operations complete, and then destroys the context.

parameters.name: ctx_id
parameters.description: The ID of the AIO context to destroy

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, errno is set

errors.description: The context pointed to is invalid.
The AIO context specified by ctx_id is invalid.
io_destroy() is not implemented on this architecture.
